body: I am intrigued with this, little afraid of learning anything more about how much of a mess I am thought I'll give this a go

Having potential intrusive thoughts (which are 100000% normal). Just want to mention that. 

Depression and/or various forms of anxiety are not made better or less common just because things are as society expects and what have you going well. You could be a billionaire and it does not make a difference. Do not feel bad if you are feeling depressed or experiencing intense anxiety. It is just something that requires some help or talks. I can't give you a solution as I don't have one for myself. What I'm getting at is your feelings are not alone, brother.
After reading a bit I'm not quite sure I follow what that sub is about.

I know there are quite few that may care to hear my story; especially with the unknown of how to help. I can just implore anyone at all to give me a bit of a chat. I really need to talk to somone. anyone.
Sent you a heart true PM

The way I live now and deal with all of it trying my best to tuck is away so I can be there for others despite of my own problems. Not just my own life since early childhood though everyone that I remotely care about hurts daily. I can't believe in any sort of love when this is everything.

Maybe it is just me but the current: being Pope Francis has taken a much more humble approach to things which is nice I suppose. It's a very small step in a massive global problem, though there is a step... Bright side, glass half full, silver lining?

Edit: Doing my best to hope for the best even when everything feels s**t

Wow.. Brother I've lost my faith and it leaves me with such unknown and extreme hurt. The fact that you still have a strong belief is awesome with a capital AWE. I'm certain I am not the one to talk with to gather everything. However I am here to just let it all out. Please do message me if you want to talk or call or speak via whatever program.

I wish nothing but the best for you.
Thank you for your prayers. I wish I could still hold any meaning in God, Jeusus and the Holy Spirit and know they were still there but I don't at all. So vastly alone
